title: SDSS white-dwarf Balmer-profile legacy audit
question: Are the broad Balmer depressions visible robustly in the preserved spectrum plot?
results: 3 of four marked Balmer depressions exceed 8% in the digitized display
broad absorption is consistent with the pipeline WD label, but atmospheric parameters are not fitted
validation: Relative depths are recomputed across four line-window widths.
provenance: Original SDSS position and pipeline WD subclass
limitations: plot digitization loses errors and spectral resolution
temperature and gravity require atmosphere-model fitting
